# BBSForm

*Common*

A BBS form (a model, a label, a particle effect and other kinds) with its transform, hitbox and visibility, from

`scram.form(formData)` or the forms of players, NPCs and blocks. Forms given by entities and blocks are copies: change them, then give them back (e.g. `setForm`). Setters return this form, so calls can be chained.

Methods of one kind of form (e.g. [`setText`](#settext) of labels) throw an error on other kinds. Every property of any kind is also reachable by its data key with [`getProperty`](#getproperty) and [`setProperty`](#setproperty).

```js
var form = scram.form('{id:"bbs:label"}').setText("Hello").setColor(0xFF8800);

form.getTransform().setScale(2, 2, 2);
c.getPlayer().setForm(form);
```

### addPart {#addpart}

::: member

Attaches a copy of a form to a bone, e.g. a hat to the head of a model.

```js
player.setForm(player.getForm().addPart(scram.form(hatData), "head"));
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `part` | [`BBSForm`](/scripting/common/bbs/BBSForm) | form to attach; this form gets a copy |
| `bone` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | name of the bone, empty or null for the form's origin |

**Returns** [`BBSForm`](/scripting/common/bbs/BBSForm) — this form

:::

### addPart {#addpart-2}

::: member

Attaches a copy of a form to the origin of this form.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `part` | [`BBSForm`](/scripting/common/bbs/BBSForm) | form to attach, not null; copied |

**Returns** [`BBSForm`](/scripting/common/bbs/BBSForm) — this form

:::

### getProperties {#getproperties}

::: member

**Returns** `List<String>` — data keys of the properties of this form, for [`getProperty`](#getproperty) and [`setProperty`](#setproperty)

:::

### getProperty {#getproperty}

::: member

Reads any property by its data key, also of kinds of forms without their own methods.

```js
var max = form.getProperty("max"); // line width of a label
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `key` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | data key, see [`getProperties()`](#getproperties) |

**Returns** `Any` — a boolean, number or string for simple properties (`0xAARRGGBB` for colors, the ID for textures, null for no texture), else the property as BBS data

:::

### setProperty {#setproperty}

::: member

Changes any property by its data key, also of kinds of forms without their own methods.

```js
form.setProperty("billboard", true).setProperty("max", 120);
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `key` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | data key, see [`getProperties()`](#getproperties) |
| `value` | `Any` | a boolean, number or string for simple properties (`0xRRGGBB` or `0xAARRGGBB` for colors, a texture ID or null for textures), else BBS data as [`getProperty`](#getproperty) gives it |

**Returns** [`BBSForm`](/scripting/common/bbs/BBSForm) — this form

:::
